customerJobs.title: Track Every Account
customerJobs.note: Record income and expenses across several accounts and currencies in one place.

customerJobs.title: Share With Family
customerJobs.note: Let a partner or relative see or edit one account without exposing the rest.

customerJobs.title: Understand Spending
customerJobs.note: See daily to yearly trends and category breakdowns without waiting on slow reports.

customerJobs.title: Keep Records Organised
customerJobs.note: Tag, group and recover transactions as categories and habits change.

pains.title: Balance Drift
pains.note: Floating-point math makes balances slightly wrong and hard to reconcile.

pains.title: Untraceable Edits
pains.note: Balances change in place with no record of who changed what.

pains.title: All-or-Nothing Sharing
pains.note: Sharing means giving full access or duplicating the account.

pains.title: Slow Dashboards
pains.note: Trend charts rescan the whole history as transactions pile up.

pains.title: Lost Context on Delete
pains.note: Removing a tag or category erases historical meaning.

gains.title: Exact Balances
gains.note: Totals match to the cent, with no negative-balance surprises.

gains.title: Auditable History
gains.note: Every balance change leaves an append-only ledger entry.

gains.title: Granular Sharing
gains.note: Owner, Admin, Editor or Viewer access chosen per account.

gains.title: Fast Analytics
gains.note: Trend and category views load from rollups, not raw history.

gains.title: Safe Cleanup
gains.note: Deleted tags and groups can be restored from a recycle bin.

productsAndServices.title: Precision Ledger Engine
productsAndServices.note: decimal.js helpers with non-negative checks, backed by an immutable AccountLedger table.

productsAndServices.title: Account RBAC
productsAndServices.note: AccountUserRole junction entity and NestJS guards for per-account roles.

productsAndServices.title: Incremental Summary Engine
productsAndServices.note: Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and category summaries updated on every write.

productsAndServices.title: Tagging Subsystem
productsAndServices.note: Hierarchical tag groups with soft delete and restore.

productsAndServices.title: Next.js Client
productsAndServices.note: Dashboards, reports and account management over 11 Zustand stores.

painRelievers.title: Arbitrary-Precision Math
painRelievers.note: safeAdd and safeSubtract replace floating-point arithmetic across the ledger.

painRelievers.title: Append-Only Audit Trail
painRelievers.note: Each change is written to AccountLedger, so edits are never silent.

painRelievers.title: Per-Account Guards
painRelievers.note: Authorisation is checked per account, separate from global JWT login.

painRelievers.title: Pre-Aggregated Reads
painRelievers.note: Analytics endpoints read six summary entities instead of scanning transactions.

painRelievers.title: Soft Delete & Recycle Bin
painRelievers.note: Tags and groups are flagged, not erased, so history keeps its context.

gainCreators.title: Money Math in One Place
gainCreators.note: Every balance change routes through a single helper module.

gainCreators.title: Transactional Summaries
gainCreators.note: Rollups update in the same transaction as the ledger write, so they stay consistent.

gainCreators.title: Roles Without Duplication
gainCreators.note: Collaborators get exactly the access they need on shared accounts.

gainCreators.title: Uniform Feedback
gainCreators.note: An ApiResponseToast bridge gives consistent success and error messages on every mutation.
